name: Competition Authority of Kenya
about: Kenya's competition regulator. It decides whether mergers may go ahead and on what conditions.

name: COMESA Competition Commission
about: Reviews mergers that reach across the COMESA common market.

name: East African Community Competition Authority
about: Reviews mergers that reach across the East African Community.

name: Capital Markets Authority
about: Regulates Kenya's capital markets, including public offers and take-overs of listed companies.

name: Capital Markets Tribunal
about: Hears appeals against decisions of the Capital Markets Authority.

name: Central Bank of Kenya
about: Licenses and supervises Kenya's banks and approves changes in their ownership.

name: Public Private Partnerships Committee
about: Approves public private partnership projects as they move from feasibility to procurement.

name: Prudential Authority of the South African Reserve Bank
Central banks in Airtel Money's markets
about: Each central bank decides whether a new owner may control a payments business in its market.
